subject: SOC 2 tabletop deliverables + SIG/CAIQ crosswalk for procurement review
messages:
From: Paul Hughes <paul.hughes@greenfin.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.company
Cc: security@greenfin.com, Karen Li <karen.li@auditors.co>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Request: SOC 2 tabletop artifacts + SIG/CAIQ mapping for pre-contract review

Hi Laura,

We're nearing legal review on the pilot agreement and our procurement team has asked for materials to validate your incident response capabilities ahead of final sign-off. Specifically, can you provide:

- A SOC 2-friendly tabletop packet that we can walk through with our security operations team (scenario, playbook excerpts, expected timelines).
- A SIG/CAIQ crosswalk or mapping that shows where Redwood's existing artifacts satisfy the SIG/CAIQ questions we sent earlier.
- Any redacted example evidence (audit logs, ticket exports) that demonstrate detection -> escalation -> remediation flow.

We'd like to review by Monday 11/30 if possible. If you have a single artifact bundle or a short deliverable list and a link to a shared folder, that will help speed things on our side. Also let us know if there are constraints around sharing raw logs (we can accept sanitized samples).

Thanks,
Paul Hughes
Head of Security Operations
GreenFin Capital
paul.hughes@greenfin.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.company>
To: Paul Hughes <paul.hughes@greenfin.com>
Cc: rohan_mehta@redwood.company, security@greenfin.com
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 tabletop artifacts + SIG/CAIQ mapping for pre-contract review

Paul — thanks for the clear ask. We can absolutely provide a compact tabletop deliverable and a SIG/CAIQ crosswalk.

Quick notes / questions:
- We'll prepare a tabletop packet (PDF) that includes one representative scenario, the IR play sequence, owner responsibilities, and time-to-detect / time-to-contain expectations.
- For SIG/CAIQ crosswalk: we will produce an XLSX mapping rows -> artifacts (policy, control evidence, config screenshots).
- We can include sanitized audit-log snippets for the detection/remediation timeline; confirm if GreenFin requires WORM-certified logs or simple redacted samples.

Plan: I will assemble the artifacts and share a Drive link by COB Monday (11/30). If that's tight for you, we can prioritize the tabletop packet + crosswalk first and deliver the sample logs as a follow-on within 48 hours.

Looping in Rohan Mehta (Security Engineering) to pull the logs and Grace O'Connor (Compliance) to assemble the SOC2 artifacts.

If Paul or Karen (cc) want a 20–30 minute walkthrough on Monday morning, we can schedule.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.company
(650) 555-0123

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.company>
To: rohan_mehta@redwood.company, grace_oconnor@redwood.company

Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: INTERNAL: GreenFin - assemble tabletop + SIG/CAIQ crosswalk (due COB 11/30)

Team — GreenFin procurement wants tabletop artifacts + SIG/CAIQ mapping by COB Monday. Summary of deliverables and owners: 

1) SOC2 tabletop packet (Laura to own final packaging) — Rohan: please attach the IR scenario playbook excerpt and the detection/remediation timeline screenshots from PagerDuty/Datadog. Include expected RTO/RPO and escalation flow.
2) SIG/CAIQ crosswalk spreadsheet (Grace to own mapping) — Populate sheet with Question ID, Redwood artifact location, and a short note on scope/limitations. Use the CAIQ subset GreenFin shared (I put the list in the Drive folder).
3) Sanitary log snippets (Rohan) — redacted timestamps and UUIDs only; do not share PII. If we need additional anonymization, flag it.
4) Executive IR summary (Ben) — 1-page PDF that summarizes our IR posture and operational cadence for auditors.

Attachments I will include in the bundle: IRP_executive-summary.pdf (stub), SOC2_tabletop_artifacts_v1.pdf (draft), SIG-CAIQ_crosswalk_greenfin.xlsx (working).

Deadlines: please drop drafts into the shared folder (https://drive.redwood.company/shared/greenfin-soc2/) by EOD Sunday so I can finalize Monday morning. If any item will slip, call out ETA ASAP.

Thanks — Laura

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.company>
To: Paul Hughes <paul.hughes@greenfin.com>
Cc: Karen Li <karen.li@auditors.co>, rohan_mehta@redwood.company, grace_oconnor@redwood.company
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Deliverable: SOC2 tabletop packet + SIG/CAIQ crosswalk (GreenFin)

Paul / Karen — attaching the initial artifact bundle we discussed. Summary below and quick notes on scope and next steps.

Attachments (stubs enclosed):
- SOC2_tabletop_artifacts_v1.pdf — tabletop packet with one representative scenario, playbook excerpts, contact matrix, and estimated timelines for detection/escalation/remediation.
- SIG-CAIQ_crosswalk_greenfin.xlsx — mapping of SIG/CAIQ questions (sheet 1) to Redwood artifacts and evidence locations (sheet 2). Rows include direct links to screenshots or PDFs in the shared Drive.
- IRP_executive-summary.pdf — high-level IR program summary for auditors and procurement.

Notes:
- Log samples are redacted to remove any PII; the sanitized snippets are available in the Drive folder (see link). If GreenFin's auditors require additional redaction rules, please provide the pattern and we will regenerate.
- The SIG/CAIQ crosswalk includes a column called "control_gap" where we call out items that require customer configuration (for example, customer-managed network ACLs). Items marked as "customer action" are highlighted.
- We do not include full raw logs in this package by default; if your procurement/audit team needs WORM-retained copies, we will need a data sharing NDA addendum (let me know and I can loop Legal).

Shared folder: https://drive.redwood.company/shared/greenfin-soc2/
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/GF-2026-11

If helpful, I'm available for a 25-minute walkthrough today at 3:00 PM PT to step through the packet and answer questions. Please confirm or propose an alternative.

Best regards,
Laura Bennett
Security & Compliance Manager | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.company | (650) 555-0123
